author: Unity
description:
Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station, and Made with Unity. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and decide how far you’re willing to go to stay afloat. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

Developed by: Questing Goose Studio
Published by: tinyBuild
